description: Use when creating or modifying a skill in the skill library — applies TDD to process documentation. Core cycle: RED (run a pressure scenario WITHOUT the skill, document agent rationalizations), GREEN (write SKILL.md targeting those exact failures), REFACTOR (identify new rationalizations, add explicit counters, re-test). Also for: enforcing universal patterns (AskUserQuestion format, Completion Status protocol, Boil the Lake principle, Search Before Building), checking skill author compliance via a checklist, and defining skill types (Technique, Pattern, Reference). Also for: updating an existing skill after a failed eval, auditing a skill against the authoring checklist, and converting tribal knowledge into documented triggering conditions.
